item.title: Queens of the Stone Age Return With ‘Easy Street,’ Announce Tour of Australia and NZ
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music plays in the background]
Host: "Welcome back to 'Trending on Billboard'! Today, we've got some exciting news for all you rock fans out there. The one and only Queens of the Stone Age is back with new music and a brand-new tour announcement!"
[Music transitions to a clip of Queens of the Stone Age's new single "Easy Street"]
Host: "Their latest single, 'Easy Street', features vocals from Nikki Lane and is accompanied by a quirky music video directed by Tony Wolski and Christopher Gruse. Frontman Josh Homme describes the song as 'funny because it hurts and it hurts because it's funny' - and that's exactly what they aimed to capture in the recording process."
[Clip of Josh Homme speaking plays]
Josh Homme: "We made it the way you'd make a demo. No click track, mistakes left in. It speeds up, it slows down, the claps aren't great, but they're not bad, and a bad clap adds this human thing you can't fake."
Host: "And if that's not enough, the band is also embarking on an extended tour of Australia and New Zealand, starting December 8th in Adelaide. They'll be playing a mix of outdoor and arena shows, with special guests Primus and Tropical F*ck Storm joining them on the road."
[Music transitions to a clip of Primus or Tropical F*ck Storm]
Host: "Australian and New Zealand fans will be the first to experience the band's brand-new show, which promises to be an unforgettable experience. Tickets go on sale Monday, July 20th at 11am, so mark your calendars! You can find all the tour and ticket information on livenation.com.au and livenation.co.nz."
[Closing music plays]
Host: "That's all for today, folks! Get ready to rock with Queens of the Stone Age and their amazing special guests. We'll catch you on the next episode of 'Trending on Billboard'!"
[Music fades out]
